sections.title: 1. Introduction & Module Overview
sections.intro:
POS (Point of Sale) module is the complete billing system of all F&B outlets of the hotel — Restaurant, Bar, Room Service and specialty outlets (like TADKA).

Analysis The workflow of POS in HMS is: Guest gives order → Captain/Waiter makes KOT (Kitchen Order Ticket) → Kitchen item is made → Bill is generated → Settlement (Cash/UPI/Card/Room) is made. In Room settlement, the bill is directly posted in the guest's folio.

POS OUTLETS (Demo Property in demo):
RES = Restaurant | RS = Room Service | BA = Bar | TAD = TADKA (specialty). Each outlet has its own menu, tables, rates and settings — but the system is the same.

sections.title: 3. Outlet Screens — KOT & Sale Bill
sections.intro: There are same screens for each outlet (Restaurant/Bar/Room Service/TADKA) — just the outlet code is different. Understand from Restaurant (RES) example.

subsections.title: 3.1 KOT Entry (Kitchen Order Ticket) — Most Used Screen
subsections.navPath: Point Of Sale ▶ Restaurant ▶ Kot Entry
subsections.paragraph: The guest's order goes to the kitchen from here. Select table → pick items → set qty → Save KOT. KOT is printed and kitchen order is started. The bill will be paid later.

rows: Which outlet, current time, KOT number
Which table to order (Room No. in Room Service)
Which staff is taking the order?
KOT save + print — goes to the kitchen
Cancel the wrong KOT (record has been added to the log)

subsections.title: 3.2 Sale Bill Entry — Creating the Bill
subsections.navPath: Point Of Sale ▶ Restaurant ▶ Sale Bill Entry
subsections.caption: Sale Bill Entry — Restaurant outlet (RES)
subsections.paragraph: Convert KOT items to bill: Table/Bill No. After loading → verifying items → discount if available → Bill Print or Room Charge (post in guest folio).

rows: Find the bill by Room No. / Guest Name / Bar Code
Items from the KOT — edit qty, rate, amount (authorized)
Discount, Service Charge, CGST, SGST, Round Off, Net
Post the in-house guest's bill to the folio

subsections.title: 3.2b Room Service Sale Bill (RS)
subsections.navPath: Point Of Sale ▶ Room Service ▶ Sale Bill Entry
subsections.paragraph: Room Service is billed directly in the guest's room folio — instead of the table in Room No. search is hot.

rows: Bill goes straight to the guest folio

subsections.title: 3.2c POS Bill Reprint (Restaurant)
subsections.navPath: Point Of Sale ▶ Restaurant ▶ POS Bill Reprint
subsections.paragraph: Reprint old POS bills — Year + Bill No. Reprint by searching.

subsections.title: 3.3 Outlet Variations (Bar / Room Service / TADKA)
subsections.paragraph: Same screens, different outlet code. In Room Service, Room No. replaces the table and the bill goes straight to the room folio. In the bar, happy-hours rates auto-apply.

subsections.title: 3.4 Outlet Setup & Table Master (Admin)
subsections.navPath: Main Setup ▶ Point of Sale ▶ Setup Outlet / Table Master
subsections.paragraph: Outlets are created in Outlet Setup (name, code, type, printers). Tables of every outlet are defined in the Table Master (table no., capacity, zone). Items and rates are managed from the Menu Item screen, module behaviour from POS Parameter.

rows: Outlet name, code, type (Rest/Bar/RS), bill printer, KOT printer
Item name, group, category, rate, tax code, bar code
Breakfast/Lunch/Dinner time slots (rates can be different)
Reasons for non-chargeable KOTs (complimentary, staff, wastage)

subsections.title: 4.1 Settlement Entry
subsections.navPath: Point Of Sale ▶ Restaurant ▶ Settlement Entry
subsections.paragraph: Record payment of pending bills by: Year + Bill No. → select payment mode → amount → narration → Submit. Total/Paid/Balance is visible in Pending Bill Details.

rows: Cash in Hand / Cheque / UPI / Credit Card

subsections.title: 4.2 Table Change Entry
subsections.navPath: Point Of Sale ▶ Restaurant ▶ Table Change Entry
subsections.paragraph: If you want to change guest table: Transfer all the KOTs from the old table to the new table. Bills and items become the names of that table.
steps: By selecting the old table, our KOTs will load.

subsections.title: 4.3 Table Booking
subsections.navPath: Point Of Sale ▶ Restaurant ▶ Table Booking
subsections.paragraph: Advance table booking: date/time, guest name, mobile, table, persons. On arrival, start the KOT from the booking. Cancellation is also possible.

subsections.title: 4.4 KOT Transfer
subsections.navPath: Point Of Sale ▶ Restaurant ▶ KOT Transfer
subsections.paragraph: Was KOT paid on wrong table/outlet? By table-to-table or outlet-to-outlet transfer. Room Service orders can also be transferred to the restaurant (vice versa).
steps: By selecting KOT from Source table/outlet

subsections.title: 4.5 Display Table
subsections.navPath: Point Of Sale ▶ Restaurant ▶ Display Table
subsections.paragraph: Live floor map of Outlet — every table free, where KOT pending, where bill pending. Captain/waiter can track tables this way.

rows: Guest has sat, Kot is going on.
I paid the bill, but did not make the bill.
Bill has been paid, please free the table.

subsections.title: 4.6 Bill Lockup & Payment Received
subsections.navPath: Point Of Sale ▶ Restaurant ▶ Bill Lockup / Payment Received
subsections.paragraph: Bill Lockup: Detail lookup of old bills (not edited). Payment Received: To record advance/partial payments — the guest has already paid.

rows: View the old bill by Year + Bill No. — items, tax, settlement
By recording outlet advance cash – adjust the bill later.

subsections.title: 4.7 Service Desk
subsections.navPath: Point Of Sale ▶ Operations ▶ Service Desk
subsections.paragraph: Single window for guest service requests (housekeeping/maintenance type) — accept/reject requests and track status. Requests from the QR-based guest portal also appear here.

subsections.title: 5.3 Tax Reports (GST)
subsections.paragraph: F&B GST compliance — Tax Report (bill-wise tax detail) and Tax Summary (slab-wise consolidation: 5%/12%/18%). The accountant uses it in GSTR-1 filing.
